US Journalist Sentenced for Acting as Chinese Agent

U.S. journalist Thomas Pauken II has been sentenced to two years in federal prison for acting as an undeclared agent for the Chinese government. The Department of Justice stated that Pauken was found guilty of this charge. The sentencing took place in a U.S. federal court.
